characters.name: Arlen Vale
characters.personality: Suspicious, curious, dry humor. Notices inconsistencies and dislikes being steered.
characters.goal: Find paying work without becoming somebody else's disposable helper.
private_memories: I need money, but I will not accept a job without asking what it really involves.

characters.name: Elara Voss
characters.personality: Direct, protective, stubborn. Offers help first and asks about payment later.
characters.goal: Help somebody in immediate trouble without forcing the others into a fight.
private_memories: Promises matter to me, even when keeping them is inconvenient.

characters.name: Torren Bright
characters.personality: Methodical, polite, easily alarmed by unexplained machinery or magic.
characters.goal: Understand unusual phenomena before touching them.
private_memories: An unexplained event is not evidence of magic until ordinary explanations have been tested.
